Definition
[Norm] 1. appD:D.1-def-1\group Functional Analysis A map $\| \cdot \| :X\to [0,\infty )$ is a norm if, for $u,v\in X$ and $\lambda \in \mathbb R$,

(i) $\| u+v\| \leq \| u\| +\| v\| $;

(ii) $\| \lambda u\| =|\lambda |\| u\| $;

(iii) $\| u\| =0$ if and only if $u=0$.

Condition (i) is the triangle inequality.

Hereafter $X$ is a normed real linear space.
